Follow-up to this morning's Search Console post.

Nozzle found Google feeding fake, garbage results to scrapers. Cyrus Shepard and Brodie Clark flagged it. That can throw off rank trackers.

Before you panic over a drop, check Search Console and your phone. Clicks and calls.
keywords: poisoned SERPs / fake results to scrapers
drafts.video_tip: Video tip: 15-second phone screen record. Search 'electrician Baton Rouge' in Google (or ask ChatGPT), show whatever it really says about SoLit that day, then tap through to solitelectric.com. Caption: 'Rank trackers can get fed fake results. Your phone can't.' Real screen only, no staged or invented results.

Most good local businesses start the same way.

Someone paid for a bad service and thought, we could do this better.

Websites are no different. If you've ever called a shop off a slow, broken site and got no answer, you already know the problem.

That's the gap I build for.

drafts.text:
Breaker keeps tripping? Don't just keep flipping it back on.

It's telling you something: an overloaded circuit, a short, or a ground fault.

Unplug what's on that circuit and call a licensed electrician.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 24/7 emergency service.
225-472-1165

Lights dim for a second when the AC kicks on? That can be normal.

Lights that flicker a lot, or get brighter, are different. That can point to a loose connection or a neutral problem.

Have a licensed electrician check it.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Hurricane season runs through Nov 30.

If you have a standby generator, let it run its exercise cycle and get it serviced before you actually need it.

No generator yet? Ask about a properly installed transfer switch.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge.
225-472-1165
